decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit that matches the firm's core plural-component and injection technology and still had its own page in 2019, management is likely to continue it because visible engineering investment and strategic fit encourage persistence.

This resin injection unit also sits close to the firm's established application equipment business and was still prominently presented in 2019, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal relatively unlikely.

An automatic airless spray gun is highly central to the firm's long-standing spray application offer, and the dedicated product-page presence suggests enough public commitment and sunk development effort to keep backing it.

The manual airless spray gun is a core-line product for this machinery maker, so even if results were mixed management would tend to retain it rather than admit a mistaken launch in such a familiar category.
Because the air-assisted airless spray gun is closely aligned with the firm's main coating equipment business and remained separately promoted in 2019, management would likely keep it on the market.

The data logger appears less central to the firm's traditional mechanical equipment focus and had already lost stand-alone prominence by 2019, so with weaker visible commitment it is the most likely product to be discontinued.
